_why: P3110 (01/11/2026 Paris): known, FIXED crash signatures for autonomous Bastien diag replies. A reply is sent only when ALL `match` regexes hit the diag text, the reported app version is BELOW `fixedVersion`, and `released` is true (the fixed build is installable). Flip `released` only once Athom has the build live/test. Add entries by hand (human push; bots may not edit this file).

match: (heap out of memory|HEAP-SENTINEL|Reached heap limit|ERR_STRING_TOO_LONG|Allocation failed)

cause.fr: l'application a manqué de mémoire pendant un traitement de données (JSON.parse) en arrière-plan, sans lien avec une action de votre part
cause.en: the app ran out of memory while processing data in the background (JSON.parse), unrelated to anything you did
